mapper.sql: av.verification_id as "verificationId", av.achievement_id as "achievementId", av.evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", av.handler_user_id as "handlerUserId", av.action_type as "actionType", av.previous_status as "previousStatus", av.next_status as "nextStatus", av.opinion as "opinion", av.evidence_ref as "evidenceRef", av.reason_code as "reasonCode", av.processed_by as "processedBy", av.processed_at as "processedAt", av.change_reason as "changeReason"
mapper.select:
select from achievement_verifications av
order by av.processed_at desc, av.verification_id desc limit #{criteria.safeSize} offset #{criteria.offset}
select from achievement_verifications av where av.achievement_id = #{achievementId} order by av.processed_at desc, av.verification_id desc limit 1
select count(*) from achievement_verifications av where av.achievement_id = #{achievementId} and (av.handler_user_id = #{handlerUserId} or av.handler_user_id is null)

select count(*) from business_status_transitions where business_type = 'FACULTY_ACHIEVEMENT' and definition_version = 'CONFIRMED' and from_status_code = #{fromStatus} and to_status_code = #{toStatus} and executor_role_code = 'R09'
select count(*) from rejection_reasons where reason_code = #{reasonCode} and business_type = 'FACULTY_ACHIEVEMENT' and active_yn = 'Y'

insert into achievement_verifications (achievement_id, evaluation_year, handler_user_id, action_type, previous_status, next_status, opinion, evidence_ref, reason_code, processed_by, changed_by, change_reason, created_by, updated_by) values (#{achievementId}, #{evaluationYear}, #{handlerUserId}, #{actionType}, #{previousStatus}, #{nextStatus}, #{opinion}, #{evidenceRef}, #{reasonCode}, #{processedBy}, #{processedBy}, #{changeReason}, #{processedBy}, #{processedBy}) returning verification_id as "verificationId", achievement_id as "achievementId", evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", handler_user_id as "handlerUserId", action_type as "actionType", previous_status as "previousStatus", next_status as "nextStatus", opinion as "opinion", evidence_ref as "evidenceRef", reason_code as "reasonCode", processed_by as "processedBy", processed_at as "processedAt", change_reason as "changeReason"
